🚛 Welcome to Truck Log!

Forward here:
• load (Trip ID / PU# / Total Rate)
• settlement text (Grand Total)
• fuel receipt (Total / gallons)

The bot works even when the app is closed.

📥 /import — bulk import (HTML, Relay, CSV)
🔄 "Restore" or /restore — restore everything from the bot archive.
Commands: /help · /status · /stats

📋 How to use the Truck Log bot:
1. Forward Amazon Relay load text
2. Or settlement / fuel receipt text
3. Data will be saved in the Truck Log app

🔄 Restore: type "restore" or /restore — the bot will reload all saved messages into the app.

/dedup — scan the database and remove duplicates

The app can be closed — the bot runs in the background on your phone.
/status — record count in database · /stats — weekly statistics
